all_place_local_point_lemma.statement: For every place v of Q, U(Q_v) is nonempty. Consequently q_H(U(Q_v)) is nonempty for every audited H and every v.

real_place.reason: all seven values are positive real numbers and therefore have nonzero real square roots

odd_prime_place.square_unit_lemma: For odd p, every u in Z_p^* with u=1 mod p is a square in Q_p: apply Hensel to T^2-u at T=1, since f(1)=0 mod p and f'(1)=2 is nonzero mod p.

prime_2_place.square_unit_lemma: An odd 2-adic unit is a square in Q_2 iff it is 1 mod 8.

all_place_local_point_lemma.scheme_link: The exact sign-cover model adjoins square roots of x,y,z,x+y,x+z,y+z,x+y+z. The displayed local square roots therefore give points of the branch-free endpoint open U(Q_v).
all_place_local_point_lemma.quotient_push: Audited 36-03 gives Q-defined finite etale q_H:U->U_H for every audited representative, so each displayed local endpoint point pushes to q_H(U(Q_v)).
all_place_local_point_lemma.torsor_K_check: Because each quotient local point is obtained by an actual lift in U(Q_v), its localized H-torsor class is trivial; this is the local analogue of the exact 36-04 lifting criterion.

single_place_route_decision.reason: for every place v and every audited H an explicit point of q_H(U(Q_v)) exists, so no fixed place can make the exact local receiver image empty

local_global_firewall.meaning: independent local points at every completion exclude a one-place emptiness argument only; they do not settle any global reciprocity or rational-point question
